subject: Logic
title: Proof by Contradiction
description: A 60-second lesson on Proof by Contradiction.

hook.text: Assume the opposite of what you want to prove. If that leads to nonsense, the original must be true.

buildup.text: Proof by contradiction—also called reductio ad absurdum—has been a power tool since ancient Greece.

discovery.text: Assume there's a largest prime number. Multiply all primes and add one. The result proves there must be another.

twist.text: You never find the truth directly. You show the alternative is impossible. The truth survives by elimination.

climax.text: This method works especially well for impossibility claims—proving something can't exist.

punchline.text: Assume it's false. Watch it implode.

quiz.question: How does proof by contradiction work?
options: Assume the statement is true and verify
Assume the opposite and show it leads to a logical impossibility
